author: Hacktivism
body:
This is not a team that will be competing in the tournament.

Greetings, we are a team composed of proficient objective players in both DTM and CTW gamemodes. We are seeking active members who show exemplary skill in both rushing and teamwork. The ultimate goal of the team is to help each other improve, share rushing tactics, and most importantly, practice constantly. We will be practicing often in public servers, and, once again, will not be taking part in any official or unofficial tournaments or scrimmages.

You may join even if you're in another tournament team.

- NinjaBridge (Co-leader)

replies.author: Mehrp
replies.body:
I decided i might as well join as you say that the primary goal of the team is to "help each other improve, share rushing tactics, practice constantly" and that sounds interesting to me so hey, why not take a shot at it?
IGN:Awesomerp
Age:This is public, so no age here .-.
Timezone:GMT
Monument Count: it says 2779 but i think the actual count is close to 2200
Skype: I'd prefer your's if i get accepted as mine is quite literally my full name 
Describe my abilities: Well, to start off i'd like to think that im quite tactical in rushing and in long matches-but this of course  i'd prefer to keep as my strategies do depend quite heavily around this tactic. I do have my good moments-i can ninja bridge horizontally and diagonally but i do occasionally fall off .-. i can block-place jump thing and my aims quite good. My internet is pretty bad-if im lagging then it is very hard to build a bridge-even without ninja'ing it (the bridge goes poof). Another of my abilites is can can make a decent beatboxing thingymagjic. And although i do like to talk nonsense, i can be sensible if needed. Back on topic, i am ok at pvp, but not actually 'pro', lets face it. .-. Anyways, i'd like to see what you think-i do like the idea of 'sharing tactics' as i would think that i have quite a few to give, particularly in the area of minimizing risk when rushing.

-Merp

replies.author: Petlas
replies.body:
IGN: Petlas
Age (optional): 14.
Timezone: UTC (+10) (I'm in Australia.)
Monument count: 71, but I was barely active when I first joined.
Skype: I wish I could provide a name in this area, but my Skype virus'ed up my PC and busted a while ago, sorry. :/
Describe your abilities in a well-written paragraph: For starters, although I've been a member of Avicus since late 2013, I haven't been a loyal and dedicated member a majority of the time. And when I did pop in to play on the server, I was a hella noob with PVP, so I've been hanging around with low statistics for a while. So excuse the low amount of kills/monuments, etc.

In a game of Nebula (I still call it that ;p) I will usually tend to rush for a monument through underground tunnels and bridges, and that method usually works well. I will also use above ground rushing, but I'm not really  much of a skybridger, to be honest. 

I also believe that using a bow with me has much greater skill than having a sword, in terms of accurate aiming, precision and timing. Of course, I'm still good with sword PVP, but using a bow is a huge strength to me.

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
IGN: Rapturous (DaBaderMC)
Age (optional):  no.
Timezone: EST
Monument count: 642 (I broke some on NuclearDucky, too. Maybe around 40)
Skype: dabadger.sweggington
Describe your abilities in a well-written paragraph: A few of my rushing abilities are wall running, Shift-unshift bridging, and staircasing. Wall running is one of the easiest things I do because all I have to do is smash my right click and run along a wall. This is perfect for escaping enemies or getting somewhere quickly. The shift-unshift bridge is an ability almost all rushers can do. It is used to go much faster and can be used to get to monuments, bases, and much more. This ability could help in many ways such as being harder to get shot off. Lastly, staircasing is a tactic I am decent at. I can usually do one without shift and most of the time, one with shift and unshift. As you can see, my sleeve is full of tricks. :^)
